final: WITH pa AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, a.frequency AS frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS acc_avg FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') GROUP BY t.account_id, a.frequency), f AS (SELECT account_id, frequency, acc_avg, AVG(acc_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS freq_avg FROM pa) SELECT account_id, frequency, acc_avg, acc_avg * 1.0 / freq_avg AS ratio FROM f ORDER BY (acc_avg * 1.0 / freq_avg) IS NULL, acc_avg * 1.0 / freq_avg DESC LIMIT 10
